description: Photograph depicting a landscape dominated by dry, tussock-forming grasses and scrubland under a clear blue sky. In the foreground, dense clumps of light-coloured grasses with visible seed heads are prominent. The middle ground transitions to sparser, lighter-coloured vegetation and bare earth or sand, leading to distant low hills visible in the background.
